sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Painful affections of the stomach; ulcera-
tion. Vomiting of food, and indurations, constant burn-
ing pain. Stricture of oesophagus, with burning pains
behind sternum, where food seems to stick. Vomiting
of food, and indurations in left hypochondrium with
constant burning pain.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Fissures form about the muco-cutaneous out-
lets. E^)ithelioma of lips or anus. Ulcerative stage of
carcinoma cutis when fissures form.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Astcrias; Conium; Hy~
drast.; Arsenic.

Dose, — Tincture, or bark, 5-grain doses before meals
in water.
